args.summary: The v2.3.1 deploy of checkout-api began failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of ~18%. In response, the service was rolled back in all regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback completed and verified: all regions now run v2.3.0, service is healthy, error rate back to ~0.2%. Follow-up: investigate v2.3.1 (and its unhealthy v2.3.1-rc staging predecessor) before any re-deploy.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

**Diagnosis**
- checkout-api v2.3.1 (latest deploy) was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
- The most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

**Actions taken**
1. **Rolled back** all production regions to v2.3.0 — completed and verified: all three regions now run v2.3.0, service is healthy, error rate down to ~0.2%.
2. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api, documenting the failure and the rollback; the on-call engineer has been paged.

**Recommendation:** Before attempting to redeploy, investigate v2.3.1 (note its predecessor v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging, suggesting the issue predates the production deploy).
